args.code: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('material-table row, [role="row"]'); const out = []; rows.forEach(r => { const cells = r.querySelectorAll('[role="gridcell"], material-table-cell'); const texts = []; cells.forEach(c => { const t = c.innerText || c.textContent || ''; if (t.trim()) texts.push(t.trim().replace(/\s+/g,' ')); }); if (texts.length > 1) out.push(texts.join(' | ')); }); return JSON.stringify(out.slice(0, 80)); })()
